messages.content: Recommend one fruit for a smoky ham flatbread. Answer in one sentence.
Pinapple adds a bright sweet-tart contrast to smoky ham flatbread.
Name one fruit to stir into spicy black-bean salsa. Answer in one sentence.
Pinapple brings sweet acidity that balances spicy black-bean salsa.
Suggest one fruit for sweet-and-savory fried rice. Answer in one sentence.
Pinapple gives sweet-and-savory fried rice a juicy, tangy lift.
Choose one fruit to pair with cottage cheese. Answer in one sentence.
Pinapple pairs well with cottage cheese for a sweet, tangy contrast.
